plan.title: RFQ invitation notification to invited vendors

steps.note: Start an RFQ event creation flow.
Provide the required event title that the invitation should contain.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction stage.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the required RFQ line item.
Commit a close time that should be reflected in invitations.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors, corresponding to Vendors A and B.
Publish the RFQ and trigger the product's vendor invitation process.
Assert that publishing succeeded and the event has a real project page.
Check the supplier-side event access for one invited QA vendor.
Open the plan's event from the invited vendor's supplier portal without asserting the email itself.
Assert that the invited vendor's event overview loaded in the supplier portal.
Return to the buyer session before requesting the mailbox-only verification.

args.need: open both QA vendor mailboxes and verify that each has exactly one invitation for this event containing the title, close time, and a link that opens the event in that vendor's portal

steps.note: Mailbox contents, invitation counts, email fields, and opening both vendors' invitation links are not observable through the catalog.
Assert the buyer's published event remains available after the mailbox verification.
